releaseNotes:
NChat 1.0.77 makes reactions and live updates more reliable.

A reaction you add can no longer disappear because a request was repeated: the app now tells the server exactly the state you tapped, and the server keeps it — the same for removing one.

Behind the scenes, a live update (a new message, a read tick, a group event) can no longer fail a save that already succeeded. What you see stays in step with what is stored.

No changes to how messages, photos, voice notes and calls work. Package identity and the verified signing key are unchanged.
